items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I mentioned before this doing an album with Paul Whiteman which featured his old players, Tom and Jim Dorsey

ctx.x: One minute after the last show, we had cabs waiting, and we did -- at the Paramount, a show at the Paramount, we had cabs waiting and we rushed down to Victor Studios on 24th Street and did a four sided record date with Tom Dorsey, and that, I believe was my last association with Tom, and of course, the last recordings with the exception
of the previous -- I mentioned before this doing an album with Paul Whiteman which featured his old players, Tom and Jim Dorsey, and that is the end of my association with Tom.

It wasn't long after that that Tommy Dorsey choked on some food while he was sleeping and died, and it was no more than ayear later that my dear friend, Jimmy, died in I think it was St. Claire Hospital, New York, of cancer.
